panel.title: About this section
panel.collapsed_hint: Help is hidden. Click the header to open it.

k_factor.title: K-factor
k_factor.body: Rating sensitivity coefficient. Higher means a single match changes Elo more. Newcomers start at K=60 and K decreases with experience.

super_tiebreak.title: Super-tiebreak
super_tiebreak.body: Tiebreak to 10 points (win by 2). Often played instead of a third set — saves 30+ minutes.

no_ad.title: No-ad
no_ad.body: At 40-40, one decisive point is played (no advantage). The receiver picks the side. Amateur-league classic.

snake_seeding.title: Snake seeding
snake_seeding.body: Group seeding: group 1 gets #1, group 2 gets #2... then snakes back. Distributes strength evenly.

comped.title: Comped
comped.body: Lesson given for free (promo, comp, friend). Unlike “unpaid” — this is intentional, not a debt.

walkover.title: Walkover (WO)
walkover.body: Match awarded without play, when an opponent doesn't show / withdraws before the match.

rrule.title: RRULE
rrule.body: iCal standard for recurring events. Example: “every Tue/Thu at 6 PM for 8 weeks”.

liga_tennisa.title: Liga Tennisa
liga_tennisa.body: Amateur tennis league at https://www.ligatennisa.com/ — 2700+ ranked players. We can import your rating from there as a starting point and display it as a secondary badge on your card.

lt_tier.title: Liga Tennisa tier
lt_tier.body: Skill bracket on Liga Tennisa: Rookies → Satellite → Futures → Legger → Challenger → Masters → Supreme → Pro. Derived from the Elo bands used on ligatennisa.com.

primary_club.title: Primary club
primary_club.body: A player or coach can be a member of multiple clubs, but only one is marked as primary. The primary club appears as a badge next to the player/coach name across the platform. Change it in /me/clubs.

club_admin.title: Club co-admin
club_admin.body: An approved club member with role 'admin'. Can approve/reject applications, remove members, edit settings and the invite token. Cannot delete the club and cannot grant the admin role to others — that's the owner's prerogative.

club_join_policy.title: Club join policy
club_join_policy.body: Three modes: approval (player applies, owner approves), open (one-click join, auto-approved), closed (invite link only).

club_invite_token.title: Club invite link
club_invite_token.body: A reusable URL of the form /clubs/join/<token> that auto-joins the user into the club. Used by closed clubs. You can set an expiry and rotate the token any time — the previous URL stops working immediately.

club_ownership_transfer.title: Club ownership transfer
club_ownership_transfer.body: A two-step handover: the current owner nominates a candidate; the candidate accepts within 14 days. Once accepted, the candidate becomes the new owner and the previous owner is demoted to co-admin.

scrim.title: Scrim
scrim.body: A semi-transparent dark layer over the banner. It keeps the title and text readable on top of any image. We never let it drop below a safe minimum.

accent_color.title: Accent color
accent_color.body: The tournament's brand color. Applied to the apply button, the logo ring and the page's top bar. Text contrast against it is picked automatically.

theme_preset.title: Theme
theme_preset.body: Light, dark or auto. 'Auto' follows the viewer's device theme. The text color is chosen automatically for readability.
